name: PHP Scripting Engine
description: Install PHP runtime versions, FPM service, and php.ini directives
install_sudo: apt-get update && apt-get install -y php php-fpm php-cli php-mysql php-mbstring php-xml

commands.install_ver_sudo: apt-get update && apt-get install -y php{version} php{version}-fpm php{version}-cli php{version}-mysql
